content_sections.heading: AMU Aligarh Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the AMU Aligarh Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download AMU Aligarh Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: AMU Aligarh Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Record Keeper and 1 for MTS (Unskilled).

content_sections.heading: AMU Aligarh Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Record Keeper: Minimum Qualification 12th, Working computer knowledge of (MS Word/Excel), Two years experience of computer work. MTS (Unskilled): High School from any recognized board.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AMU Aligarh Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.amu.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 25-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AMU Aligarh recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the application form for the AMU Aligarh recruitment is 25 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Record Keeper and MTS posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies, with 1 for Record Keeper and 1 for MTS (Unskilled).

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the MTS post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the MTS post is High School from any recognized board.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any experience required for the Record Keeper position?
faq.answer: Yes, the Record Keeper position requires a minimum of two years of computer work experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Record Keeper post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Record Keeper post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Offline.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection criteria for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a skill/practical test and a communicative/interactive session.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Aligarh Muslim University, www.amu.ac.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is Temporary.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 01/ENT/2026.
